title: EXTERNAL_VENDOR-002 AWS critical vendor dependency
description: Deal Intelligence runs the whole production platform (Lambda, DocumentDB, S3, CloudFront, KMS, CloudTrail) on AWS in us-east-1. A prolonged regional AWS outage, account compromise or suspension, or a material change in AWS terms would halt service delivery and could expose customer data. Affects: availability (99.9 % commitment), confidentiality of customer data. AWS is one of two sub-processors (with PropelAuth) and is covered by a Data Processing Agreement. Treatment: DocumentDB in us-east-1 with storage replicated across three availability zones, automatic re-creation of the instance after any failure, including an availability-zone failure; automated backups with 35-day point-in-time recovery; quarterly backup-restore test via infrastructure as code (CloudFormation through the Serverless Framework), recorded in the compliance platform; root-account MFA and least-privilege IAM; CloudTrail with security-relevant events alerting the CEO via SNS in real time (EventBridge rule and breach-detection Lambda) and a monthly configuration-check record; annual vendor review of AWS SOC 2 / ISO 27001 reports per the Vendor Management Policy; single region by design as stated in the Business Continuity Plan. Owner: CEO.

title: CYBERSECURITY-001 Data breach or unauthorized access
description: Unauthorized access to business contact information or customer account data through compromised credentials, misconfiguration, or an unpatched vulnerability. Affects: confidentiality of customer data; 48-hour customer breach-notification commitment. Treatment: personnel MFA enforced in Google Workspace, GitHub, and AWS, customer MFA inherited from Google Workspace sign-in via PropelAuth; least-privilege IAM and RBAC; VPC isolation; KMS encryption at rest and TLS 1.2+ in transit; CloudTrail monitoring with security-relevant events alerting via SNS in real time and a monthly configuration-check record in the compliance platform; quarterly access reviews via the access-review Lambda; Dependabot, ECR scan-on-push, and Trivy in CI. Owner: CEO.

title: TECHNOLOGY-001 Service availability disruption
description: Failure of an AWS component (Lambda, Fargate, DocumentDB) or a deployment error interrupts the daily data delivery. Affects: availability (99.9 % uptime commitment). Treatment: DocumentDB storage replicated across three availability zones with automatic re-creation of the instance after any failure, including an availability-zone failure; CloudWatch alarms on API errors and latency (p95 > 2 seconds); DocumentDB backups retained 35 days with point-in-time recovery; Lambda versioned deployments with rollback via serverless rollback; Business Continuity Plan with a quarterly backup-restore test recorded in the compliance platform. Owner: CEO.

title: OPERATIONAL_PEOPLE-001 Key-person dependency — CEO holds all production access
description: The Chief Executive Officer (CEO) is the only role with production access (AWS, GitHub, DocumentDB, PropelAuth administration) and owns every policy and control. Unavailability of the CEO would interrupt operations, incident response, compliance maintenance, and customer service delivery. Affects: availability, incident response, SOC 2 control operation. Score 32.0 (probability 4, impact 3: legal 3, financial 2, reputational 3). Treatment: compensating controls per the Organizational Structure — pull request with required CI status checks on the protected main branch and a logged self-review; automated checks (the monthly configuration-check Lambda, CloudTrail) with security-relevant events alerting via SNS in real time; dated control records in the compliance platform; independent review by the external SOC 2 auditor. Treatment action (planned, due December 31 [CONFIRM: year]): document all critical processes, establish emergency access procedures with a trusted third party, and create a knowledge-transfer repository. Owner: CEO.

title: EXTERNAL_VENDOR-001 PropelAuth service disruption
description: An outage or security incident at PropelAuth (authentication sub-processor) blocks customer sign-in to the platform. Affects: availability of customer access; authentication availability is provided by PropelAuth under its own SLA. Treatment: annual vendor review per the Vendor Management Policy; monitoring of PropelAuth status; PropelAuth contingency and customer communication steps in the Business Continuity Plan. Owner: CEO.

title: COMPLIANCE_REGULATORY-001 Compliance documentation gaps
description: Policies, procedures, and evidence drift out of date between annual reviews, creating gaps against GDPR, CCPA, and SOC 2 requirements. Affects: audit readiness; regulatory obligations. Treatment: annual policy review cycle; monthly automated evidence and quarterly evidence sweep recorded in the compliance platform; compliance platform task reminders. Owner: CEO.

title: COMPLIANCE-001 Incident response capacity
description: Detection of and response to a security incident may be delayed when the CEO, as incident commander, is unavailable, affecting the 48-hour customer notification commitment and SOC 2 CC7.3–CC7.5. Affects: incident response targets; customer and regulatory notification. Treatment: breach-detection Lambda, triggered by an EventBridge rule on security-relevant CloudTrail events, that alerts the CEO via SNS in real time; Incident Response Procedure (P1 acknowledged within 4 business hours); AWS Support escalation path; annual tabletop exercise recorded in the compliance platform. Owner: CEO.
